notes.subject: ⟨mĩrĩga⟩
notes.rationale: Gĩkũyũ ĩhote gũcokia kiugo 'iriigũrũ' gĩa mbere, no hindi mbera ĩhicokia mũhiano wa kwerereria

notes.subject: mĩthingi ciothe
notes.rationale: עולאם nĩ 'thutha ũrĩ utarĩ na mũthia', gĩtaũro gĩa mũhiano: 'ciumĩte thutha-inĩ ĩgayũkanĩte'

notes.subject: ũthingu
notes.rationale: כבוד nĩ 'ũrĩa wonagwo na maithori, kĩguni, ũraihu' — ũthingu nĩ gĩtaũro gĩa mũhiano

notes.subject: to the gates
notes.rationale: Ndũkũro ĩrĩ kwarĩrĩria mĩrĩga yakwa mĩguĩ ya kũhũra mitwe — gũtirĩra kwa kĩguni gĩa kũinĩra

translation: Ihũranĩngai mitwe ianyu, iriigũrũ, na ⟨mĩrĩga⟩ ya mĩthingi ciothe ihũrwo, nĩgetha mũthamaki wa ũthingu akiingerera.
